description: This file 'h2.c' contains the implementation of an HTTP/2 protocol layer, including handling of HTTP/2 frames, stream management, settings, and connection management. It defines constants, data structures, and functions to process HTTP/2 frames such as DATA, HEADERS, SETTINGS, PING, RST_STREAM, and GOAWAY, and manages the state and flow of HTTP/2 streams within a server context.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint32_t h2_u31(const uint8_t * const s)
methods.description: Reads a 31-bit unsigned integer from a big-endian byte array, masking out the high bit.

methods.description: Reads a 24-bit unsigned integer from a byte array, optimized for the frame header parsing.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ uint16_t h2_u16(const uint8_t * const s)
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit unsigned integer from a big-endian byte array.
